outlook.statement: The management currently relies on the Company undergoing the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process for further functioning of the Company.

The Indian M&E industry is expected to reach INR 3.3 trillion by 2028, growing at over 7% CAGR with digital media, live events, filmed entertainment and animation and VFX as primary growth drivers. New media projected to account for over 50% of total industry revenues by 2028.

The Indian M&E industry is on an impressive growth path, expected to grow at a much faster rate than the global average, credited to rising incomes, increasing internet penetration and digital adoption. Rural regions expected to be next growth regions with 5G/6G rollout providing opportunities.
